seo.title: About Organix — Built in the Mountains, Made for Adventure | OrganixEvents
seo.description: The story of Organix: Stéphane, Bryan, a snowcat brought to North Macedonia and a growing family of sport and adventure experiences.

story.title: Around fifteen years in the making.
paragraphs: Organix has existed in different forms for around fifteen years, with Stéphane at its centre. Long before the snowcat, he was already organising trips in North Macedonia.
Bryan and Stéphane first met during Bryan's professional ski racing career, when Stéphane worked on his ski boots and custom footbeds.

Around two years ago, Bryan joined the project. Together they created OrganixEvents Sàrl, bought a snowcat and imported it to North Macedonia. With local partners, they developed the operation on the ground — today run locally through Wild Tracks — and then kept going, into new sport and adventure experiences.

people.name: Bryan Zooler
people.intro: Bryan spent more than ten years in international ski cross competition, as a member of the Swiss ski cross team. Racing took him to mountains all over the world — and gave him a feel for what makes a trip in the mountains work.
people.text: Since then he has put that experience into coaching, mountain sports and creating sport and adventure projects. Organix is where it all comes together.
facts: Former member of the Swiss ski cross team

people.name: Stéphane
people.intro: Stéphane has been the central figure of Organix for around fifteen years — and for just as long, he has been travelling to, working in and building relationships in North Macedonia.
facts: Around 15 years at the heart of Organix
Around 15 years of experience in North Macedonia

local.title: Local people matter.
local.text: We work with local guides, operators and people we trust. We're not outsiders importing tourism into a place — we build experiences with the people who live there, and we want the places we go to benefit from them.

final.title: Let's build the next one.
